name: George Francis Adams IV
notable_stories: Continues the long family tradition of the George Francis name, representing the sixth or seventh generation to carry it
George was named before his parents learned the family history; four George Adamses came before him.
milestones: Married Anne Marie Bainbridge on November 23, 1996
Father of George, Ted, Roy, Sam, and Mary
sources: Family letters in Bill Allen’s family document
Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: Children: George, Ted, Roy, Sam, Mary
